SPIDER-MAN · NYC PROTOTYPE

  • WASD Move (relative to camera)

  • Space Jump
  • Left Click / E Shoot web (tap again to release)

  • Run or jump into a wall to climb — W climbs, jump/pull away to let go
  • C Toggle camera distance
  • R Respawn at center
